incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 pager — KV cache eviction rate and continuous-batch latency spike across multiple clusters. Affected models: qwen-13b-mqa, llama-70b, mistral-7b. Error pattern: cache growth + eviction storm -> request backpressure. Auto-routing is flapping. Root ts: 3204456789

Ana (oncall): on it. seeing 5xxs and 2000ms tail latencies on /v1/chat/generate for qwen-mqa. marking customer-impact: yes. will try to reduce batching window first.

Jamie (eng-sre): metrics snapshot: prefix_cardinality high for qwen-mqa (x80 baseline). KV entries/host trending +400% in 10m. Eviction rate up, GC loops on shard. Logs: `ERR kv_cache: eviction_rate=0.78 entries=1.2M host=kv-14`

Mike (runtime): adding context — qwen-mqa workload shows high seqlen variance (short prompts + occasional 4096 prefix scans). Continuous batching bundling is creating very large merge windows, KV gets hot and thrashes. Also saw kernel mismatch warnings on quantized path for llama fallback when contbatch tries to merge different memory layouts.

Sarah (ml-ops): hypothesis: MQA path is causing extremely dense attention states that keep references in KV longer -> prefetch floods. Could be model-specific prefetch logic + contbatch window too large. Suggest disable prefetch for qwen models and tighten contbatch.

Ana (oncall): proposed mitigations (hotfix):
1) disable kv_prefetch for qwen-13b-mqa
2) set contbatch_window_ms=10 (was 75) globally for 15 min window
3) route llama-70b to `llama-70b-quantized-fallback` to avoid kernel mismatch

Jamie (eng-sre): +1. Also throttle client-side concurrency for top offending shard until we see drop.

Mike (runtime): ready to apply. posting admin command:
```
POST /admin/feature-flags HTTP/1.1
Host: controlplane.internal
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "kv_prefetch.qwen-13b-mqa": "off",
  "contbatch.window_ms": 10,
  "routing.llama-70b": "llama-70b-quantized-fallback"
}
```

Ana (oncall): go for it. I'll put the incident channel in read-only for noise.

deploy-bot: deploying flags to controlplane (canary: kv-14, kv-15) — PR #5824 merged by Mike — rollout start.

Mike (runtime): rollout done to canary clusters. monitoring.

Jamie (eng-sre): seeing immediate: eviction_rate -> 0.23 on kv-14, request 5xxs dropping. tail latencies start trending down. prefix_cardinality still elevated but plateauing.

Ana (oncall): customer-impact update: ~4 customers affected, intermittent errors during spike window. advising support to notify next.

Luis (support): drafting an outbound note. Short version: degraded response times and transient errors for chat endpoints using qwen-13b-mqa between 09:18–09:45 UTC. Mitigation applied, degradation resolved for most traffic. Will update with RCA.

Sarah (ml-ops): one anomaly: mistral-7b traces show increased contbatch hang for multi-model fanout requests. We should ensure contbatch window change doesn't regress low-latency models. Observing CPU bump on multitenant hosts.

Jamie (eng-sre): rolled back contbatch global change to contbatch.window_ms=20 for low-latency models, and applied targeted change for qwen models only: `contbatch.window_ms.qwen-13b-mqa = 10`.

Mike (runtime): updated flags accordingly and forced kv_prefetch.qwen-13b-mqa = off (sticky). Deploy-bot shows success across 3 regions.

deploy-bot: feature flag rollout complete — 3204457050

Jamie (eng-sre): metrics 10m after targeted changes: total 5xxs down 92%, median latency down 60%, KV entries stabilized at ~320k per host. Eviction loops stopped.

Ana (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. leaving pager open for follow-up and RCA.

Morgan (product): did customers hit data-loss or degraded outputs? any hallucinations from fallback variants?

Luis (support): no data-loss reported. Some small quality diffs for a subset routed to quantized llama fallback — customers saw a few tokenization artifacts, flagged but not severe. Offering rollback if requested.

Sarah (ml-ops): follow-ups:
- investigate why prefetch for MQA kept refs alive (likely policy bug)
- evaluate adaptive contbatch per-model based on seqlen distribution
- add guardrail: if KV growth > 200% in 5m, auto-disable prefetch for that model

Jamie (eng-sre): ops tasks:
- add a dashboard for per-model KV growth and eviction_rate alarms
- postmortem writeup focusing on model-specific prefetch heuristics and kernel path mismatches
- create playbook entries for targeted feature-flag mitigations (commands, perms)

Ana (oncall): assigning owners: Sarah -> ML investigation, Jamie -> SRE/alerts and playbook, Mike -> runtime/flag automation, Luis -> customer comms and updates.

Morgan (product): schedule customer follow-up and prioritize QA for llama quantized fallback quality.

Ana (oncall): thanks everyone. setting incident state -> mitigated. Will open a postmortem channel and ping owners. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident 3204456789 status changed to MITIGATED by Ana (oncall). Postmortem due in 72 hours.
